items.summary: Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and continue only the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation. Amazon reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21; $4.92 is in aggregate tracking_id=other and cannot be assigned to a site. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget exposure, and cost-to-learn are not calculable. AI spend is $916.914544 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-28 across 5,009 calls, with 228 errors; infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, commitments, and budget ceilings are not recorded. Do not treat missing costs as zero or treat SEO totals of 14,410 impressions, 146 clicks, 1,002 sessions, 15 conversions, 36 awaiting measurement, or 3 proven outcomes as financial results or forecasts. Continue existing work item 67ebb985-a7b8-47f4-9792-b4d727275c4a only; create no new spend, telemetry, requeues, deployments, or monetization changes.

Minimum finance measurement: reconcile all 18 named tracking rows and the aggregate provider row to matching-period site/content revenue; attach a complete cost ledger for AI, infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, experiments, and commitments; record monthly budget ceilings and an approved cost-to-learn threshold. Until those fields exist, site contribution margin and learning efficiency remain unknown. The current $916.914544 AI total can be reported as spend, but cannot be allocated into site margin beyond the supplied partial by-site rows, and the provider's $4.92 aggregate commission cannot support revenue claims.
